jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, LLM Evaluation
jobs.descriptionPlain:
Fabrikam Health helps clinics automate prior authorizations with AI.

Own the evaluation of our prior-authorization assistant.
- Build gold sets with clinicians, LLM-as-judge rubrics and regression tests that gate every release.
- Python, SQL, structured outputs, prompt engineering.
- Deploy evaluation jobs on GCP (Vertex AI pipelines, BigQuery).
- 4+ years of experience in ML engineering.
Remote across the Americas, including Latin America.

jobs.title: Generative AI Engineer
jobs.descriptionPlain:
Fabrikam Health helps clinics automate prior authorizations with AI.

Prototype and ship generative AI features: summarization of clinical documents and patient messaging.
